intelligence.essence: Every frame is built mobile-first, then laptop. The 9:16 vertical frame gives more room to write and pairs as roughly a third/two-thirds with the text board beside it on a laptop; on mobile it folds to stacked blocks — video, then the next block. Every page must be easily toggled between mobile and laptop and look great on both. If a design does not convert well both ways, we do NOT build the page that way — only frames optimized for mobile first that still look great on laptop ship.
